technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals present, but severe structural weakness across moving averages, momentum, and volume metrics creates high risk for continued downside.

fundamental.summary: HD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 56 days with elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (13/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (net neutral) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (392), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and negative macro score (-4) create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 56 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (9) with StochRSI bullish cross and Supertrend reversal signal present contrarian buy opportunity in fear-driven market (VIX 392, sentiment 13/100).
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe structural breakdown across all major moving averages, negative MACD, weak volume (CMF/OBV), no institutional conviction, unfavorable macro (rising DXY, flat yield curve, high credit spreads), and earnings risk in 56 days create high probability of continued downside despite oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold technicals (RSI 9, StochRSI cross) present contrarian setup, but structural weakness across moving averages, negative momentum, and zero institutional conviction eliminate edge. Already holding HD position adds concentration risk.
decision.primary_risk: Macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising DXY, flat yield curve, high credit spreads) combined with earnings event in 56 days create elevated probability of continued downside despite oversold bounce signals.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals show reversal signals but fundamentals, sentiment confirmation, and macro environment strongly contradict entry conviction
decision.portfolio_note: Existing HD position plus 13 open Consumer Discretionary positions (10.3% sector concentration) warrant avoiding new exposure; earnings proximity requires reduced sizing if any entry considered.
